title: Intelligenism Agent Framework (IAF) — Introduction
description: IAF is a minimal, file-based framework for multi-agent collaboration modes, designed to be operated and extended by AI agents themselves.

title: IAF Super Chat — Introduction
description: A special IAF build you talk to in plain language — it codes its own new agents and reviews and improves its own work.

title: Theory Consensus Reactor (TCR) — Architecture & Philosophy
description: A governance-constrained IAF cluster that turns a pool of agents into a decision engine, driving competing proposals toward a single winning decision.

title: Agent Werewolf — Coming Soon
description: A multi-agent adversarial demo built by chaining several IAF units together. Full write-up coming soon.
